page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.16xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated virtual machine designed for massively parallel compute workloads. Driven by the KVM hypervisor on x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 64 vCPUs derived from 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The CPU subsystem features 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a 33 MB shared L3 cache, supported by 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced 4 GB per virtual core allocation.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs delivering a cumulative 128 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM (16 GB per GPU). The host configuration lacks bundled local NVMe storage, meaning all persistence relies on network-attached block devices. Networking performance is established at a 20 Gbps baseline throughput, supporting distributed model synchronization across multiple cluster nodes.

Synthetic benchmarks reflect the architecture's operational profile. Single-core processing metrics, such as a stress-ng score of 1107.8 and single-threaded gzip throughput of 19.13 GB/sec, fall into the lower performance tiers due to the conservative 2.5 GHz base clock and absence of advanced vector extension flags like AVX-512 in the guest topology. Conversely, multi-threaded capacity scales predictably, yielding a stress-ng multi-core result of 47157.74 and 200.07 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory subsystem benchmarks show 121.44 GB/sec read and 48.0 GB/sec write throughput for large uncached blocks, complemented by 41.84 million Redis SET operations per second.

From an infrastructure cost perspective, the instance is optimized for multi-GPU utilization density rather than sequential CPU power. Deployments requiring intense single-thread compute or high-IOPS local scratch space will face architectural bottlenecks. The ecs.gn6v-c8g1.16xlarge is best suited for distributed deep learning model training, batched neural network inference, molecular dynamics simulations, and high-throughput GPU computing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance featuring 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 256 GB of system memory. Its primary capability stems from eight integrated NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs delivering 128 GB of aggregate VRAM, alongside a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance carries no bundled local storage, requiring attached network volumes for persistent data. Multi-core performance scales steadily, achieving 47157.74 on stress-ng multi-core and 41.84 million Redis operations per second, although single-core execution remains constrained by lower clock speeds and legacy vector extensions. Resource allocation balances dense GPU throughput with substantial host memory, making this server profile suitable for deep learning training, batch AI inference, and large-scale parallel mathematical simulation workloads.
